values.task_boundary: Deliver only the optional DRT-D GCP portability packet after all three dependencies are terminal and ancestral.
deliverables: Identity, continuity, cost, and cleanup-zero receipts
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Six identities and lineage remain exact.
AC-2: GCP account, project, billing, and credentials are separately governed.
AC-3: Cost and cleanup receipts are retained.
AC-4: No owned per-run resources remain.
dependencies: Explicit paid-run authorization before live launch
non_goals: Creating persistent production GCP Runtime infrastructure
Changing provider credentials or IAM policy outside the declared proof
